title: build_chain anchor-match by DN only; pkix-chain re-validates anchors it did not build the chain with
description: build_chain() stops walking when current-cert's issuer DN matches ANY trust anchor subject. Then all trust anchors are passed to pkix_chain::verify_chain_default. If the bag contains a cert whose issuer matches anchor A but whose signature was made by anchor B (e.g. cross-certificates, same-DN re-issuance), build_chain correctly terminates, but pkix-chain receives the full anchor set and may validate against a different anchor than expected. The chain passed to pkix-chain is always leaf+intermediates (no anchor), so pkix-chain independently picks the anchor. This is correct behavior but the gap is: build_chain's termination condition and pkix-chain's anchor selection can diverge on a DN collision. Risk is low but the invariant is undocumented.
close_reason: pkix-chain validates the full chain cryptographically regardless of how build_chain terminates; DN-collision at anchor level cannot bypass signature check.
